lastCompletedStory.title: Surface the merit-over-cost stance as human prose in docs/agent-readiness.md

nextStoryContext: Inserted a new prose paragraph under the existing '## Where cam is already ahead of the rubric' heading in docs/agent-readiness.md, right before '## Prioritized gap roadmap', stating cam's merit-over-cost stance in plain human-readable prose (no em-dash, no decorative emoji). The oracle greps the literal substring 'never by operational cost', which appears verbatim in 'never by operational cost.' The paragraph preserves both must-survive clauses from the US-001..US-003 agent-file rule: (1) 'This rule limits the quality of the recommendation, not its scope: simplicity remains the scope limiter' (quality-not-scope limiter, phrased to avoid licensing speculative abstraction/gold-plating) and (2) 'Operational cost is never a criterion, but quality degradation from context-window exhaustion is a quality criterion, not a cost one' (adapted to third person, 'an agent may still stop short of a fuller fix when continuing would burn through context'). Wording is deliberately NOT a verbatim copy-paste of the agent-file sentence (that sentence uses 'workaround, gambiarra, or shortcut' framed for EXECUTION; this doc's paragraph is framed for a human reader summarizing the stance across planner/implementer/reviewer/auditor, consistent with the notes field's prior-art pointer to subagent-orchestrator.md's phrasing 'never by execution cost'). No src/ or templates/ change, so no embed-vendor regen needed. Full `bun run check:all` spine green (5256 tests pass/0 fail, typecheck ok, lint ok, file-size ok, debt-markers ok, coverage ok, dead-code ok, dup ok, ci-parity ok, agents-md ok, test-sleeps ok).
